name: Calendar Notes
description: A minimal month-view calendar for keeping day-by-day notes.
releaseNotes: The settings sheet gains a fonts-and-colours pane: pick the calendar typeface (falling back to the host's font token), scale all calendar text by percentage, and zoom the whole interface including every dialog. Six colours — note text, calendar background, today and selection borders, festival and solar-term text — are individually tunable, each resettable to the theme default.
